column1: # ps components: kind  name  key  description  flags (see lib/components.sh)
mode  user  -  your processes, busiest first            default
mode  all   -  all processes, busiest first             -
mode  tree  -  process tree (input order: sorting off)  restart
toggle  kernel  alt-k  show kernel threads                      -
action  term    ctrl-x  send SIGTERM to the selected processes   silent,reload
action  kill    -       send SIGKILL to the selected processes   silent,reload,confirm
